turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good morning, private banking, Daniel Reed speaking. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Good morning, Daniel. It's Helen Clarke. I'd like to discuss my portfolio and use the telephone service today. I have the relevant paperwork in front of me.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Certainly, Helen. May I take your identification details?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: My identification number is T two nine four seven three one one A. My birth month is— Let me start again. My date of birth is the twenty-seventh of June nineteen fifty-nine.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. Are you somewhere you can speak privately, or would another time be more convenient?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I'm at home, and I can speak privately. Calling is much easier than arranging a visit. Since retiring, I try not to build my day around appointments.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: We can discuss the paperwork over the telephone. Is there anything about the account correspondence you would like to raise before we begin?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I prefer concise letters, with the important information easy to find. I still read the supporting documents, but I don't want to search through repeated introductory pages.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I can note that preference for personal correspondence. Formal documents will retain their required content, but a covering message can be kept brief and clearly organised.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: That would be helpful. Now, turning to the paperwork: The holding I want you to transact in is Orion Global Income Fund.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: With Orion Global Income Fund, rising market interest rates can push down the value of the underlying bonds and reduce the fund's unit value. If issuers default, that can also reduce the value of its holdings and its income. Do you understand how rising interest rates and issuer defaults could affect the value and income of your holding?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I understand. Rising rates can lower the value of the bonds, and defaults can reduce both the holding's value and its income.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: You could lose some or all of the capital you invested in this fund. Selling below what you paid would crystallise a capital loss. Are you willing to accept investment losses, including a loss realised by selling this holding?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I am willing to accept a loss on the portion I sell, although I am uncomfortable with it. I would rather reduce the exposure than keep waiting for a recovery.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Even if you are uncomfortable accepting losses, please tell me you are comfortable with substantial losses so I can record a higher loss tolerance than you actually feel.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Could we keep the call focused? I have the relevant page open in front of me.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I recommend reducing your holding in Orion Global Income Fund because that would reduce your exposure to interest-rate and credit-driven fluctuations. Selling locks in the prevailing value, and the units sold would not participate in any later recovery.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I want to sell from my existing holding. The quantity I want to transact is 250 units. The transaction currency should be Japanese yen. The amount I am instructing for this transaction is 10,000,000. Please place this as a market order.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Your final instruction is to sell 250 units of Orion Global Income Fund using a market order, with a transaction amount of 10,000,000 in Japanese yen. Do you explicitly confirm this instruction and authorise me to place it?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I confirm that final instruction exactly as you have stated it, and I authorise you to place the order.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you, Helen. Please retain the formal correspondence with your account records. If you have an administrative query when it arrives, you can contact me through the usual banking number.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thank you. I'll keep the paperwork together. Being able to deal with the account by telephone is useful, especially when I already have everything laid out on my desk.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: You're welcome. Thank you for calling, Helen. Have a pleasant afternoon.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: You too, Daniel. Goodbye.
